### Introduction
This chapter will introduce the different wiring modes of our vehicle-mounted MDVR series. The device uses DC power input. The normal working range of the input voltage is +8V ~ +36V. Do not connect a power supply beyond this range. If the voltage is too low, the device will not work properly. If the voltage is too high, the device may burn out.
##### Ignition mode (ACC switch or key switch):
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=f3f510bc981847e05790f15b2ea374c2)
Description: In this mode, the vehicle ACC signal is used to control the opening and closing of the device. In the off state, the power consumption is 0 and the battery power is not consumed. It is recommended to use the ignition mode.
##### Timing mode (main switch mode):
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=923ad0cba2759fe683c4042d7f59ce1d)
Description: This mode directly connects the positive and negative poles of the battery to the normal power supply state, which can realize timed power on and off or 24-hour normal power on. Please note that after the vehicle is turned off, the battery power will be consumed and there will be a risk of low voltage and inability to start the vehicle.
